=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:154-161 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The retained scalar-input `BLOCKED:` rule (also prompts/mode-plan.txt:105-112 and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt:98-105) contradicts the new "ask for a missing fact" rule at run_plan_codex.sh:213-217 (prompts/mode-plan.txt:158-163).
  WHY: A Claude planner with no web tool can follow the old rule and emit `BLOCKED:` instead of a Q/Choices clarification, which routes to the blocked path (plan.yml:1670-1690) and defeats the #7357 fix. Reviewers rated it MAJOR; the report maps that to high.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:407-427 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_ai_engine_instructions_file` creates a new `claude-instructions-*.md` temp copy in RUNNER_TEMP on every call and never deletes it.
  WHY: Copies accumulate until the job ends or the runner is cleaned, which is minor on ephemeral runners. Reviewers rated it NIT; the report maps that to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=4

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:154-161 (same wording in prompts/mode-plan.txt:105-112 and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt:98-105) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The BLOCKED rule for scalars the model "cannot derive or look up" was left unchanged while the web-access rule below it was rewritten (lines 213-217).
  WHY: A Claude planner needing a public fact it cannot fetch can emit `BLOCKED:` instead of a Q/Choices question. The "(see the web-access rule below)" parenthetical also still reads as an unconditional fetch instruction.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh: `_ai_engine_instructions_file` (mktemp "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/claude-instructions-XXXXXXXX.md") | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Each call creates a new copy of the instructions file and nothing deletes it.
  WHY: Many panel and retry calls leave small files in RUNNER_TEMP until the job ends, which costs a few KB per call.
- Hardening: scripts/ai_engine.sh `_ai_engine_instructions_file`: copies accumulate in RUNNER_TEMP. Fix: use a fixed per-run path replaced with `mv -f`, or remove the copy after the Claude run (3-5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:154-161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The retained BLOCKED rule for missing facts contradicts the new rule for asking for missing facts (lines 199-217).
  WHY: An agent may treat the BLOCKED rule as taking precedence and emit `BLOCKED:` instead of asking a clarification question, stopping the pipeline unnecessarily.
- Hardening: scripts/ai_engine.sh line 416 (mktemp): each Claude run leaves a claude-instructions-*.md in RUNNER_TEMP. Fix: remove the file after the Claude process finishes, for example with a trap (3-5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:416-422 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every Claude call leaves a `claude-instructions-*.md` behind in RUNNER_TEMP, with no cleanup after the path is consumed successfully.
  WHY: On long-lived self-hosted runners this grows without bound. It is not a security leak.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Plan/clarify prompts... now say web search exists only on Codex runs, use a fact the issue states as verified as given, and ask for a missing one instead of guessing."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-plan.txt lines 105-115, prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt lines 98-105, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh lines 154-164
  Evidence of absence: The old scalar-value BLOCKED rule remains above the new "ask" bullets (prompts/mode-plan.txt:158-163, _templates/mode-plan.txt:137-145, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:213-217) with no carve-out, so a Claude planner sees conflicting instructions. The AI_ENGINE_CLAUDE_NO_WEB_NOTE only partly mitigates this.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4 (SEVERITY: MAJOR)
- Hardening: scripts/ai_engine.sh `_ai_engine_instructions_file` (lines 407-427) and call sites claude_run (line 474), scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:237, scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:465: leaked copies. Fix: fixed-name file with `mv -f` plus an EXIT trap (about 6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Hardening: tests/test_ai_engine.py (lines 339-340): no regression test covers a failed `cat` in the `cat ... && printf ...` rewrite. Fix: `chmod 000` the source and assert the fallback to the source path (about 8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
